title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 — Core function and category titles
note: Official short titles from NIST AI RMF 1.0 Tables 1–4. Not a substitute for the full publication.

functions.title: GOVERN
functions.text: A culture of risk management is cultivated and present. GOVERN is a cross-cutting function that is infused throughout AI risk management and enables the other functions of the process.

functions.title: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization related to the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively.
functions.text: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization related to the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively.

functions.title: Accountability structures are in place so that the appropriate teams and individuals are empowered, responsible, and trained for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.
functions.text: Accountability structures are in place so that the appropriate teams and individuals are empowered, responsible, and trained for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.

functions.title: Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility processes are prioritized in the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks throughout the lifecycle.
functions.text: Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility processes are prioritized in the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks throughout the lifecycle.

functions.title: Organizational teams are committed to a culture that considers and communicates AI risk.

functions.title: Processes are in place for robust engagement with relevant AI actors.
functions.text: Processes are in place for robust engagement with relevant AI actors.

functions.title: Policies and procedures are in place to address AI risks and benefits arising from third-party software and data and other supply chain issues.

functions.title: MAP
functions.text: Context is recognized and risks related to context are identified. MAP establishes the context to frame and inform risk decisions about specific AI systems.

functions.title: Context is established and understood.
functions.text: Context is established and understood.

functions.title: Categorization of the AI system is performed.

functions.title: AI capabilities, targeted usage, goals, and expected benefits and costs compared with appropriate benchmarks are understood.

functions.title: Risks and benefits are mapped for all components of the AI system including third-party software and data.

functions.title: Impacts to individuals, groups, communities, organizations, and society are characterized.

functions.title: MEASURE
functions.text: Identified risks are assessed, analyzed, or tracked. MEASURE uses quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-method tools, techniques, and methodologies to analyze, assess, benchmark, and monitor AI risk and related impacts.

functions.title: Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied.
functions.text: Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied.

functions.title: AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.
functions.text: AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.

functions.title: Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.
functions.text: Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.

functions.title: Feedback about efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed.
functions.text: Feedback about efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed.

functions.title: MANAGE
functions.text: Risks are prioritized and acted upon based on projected impact. MANAGE entails allocating risk resources to mapped and measured risks on a regular basis and as defined by the GOVERN function.

functions.title: AI risks based on assessments and other analytical output from the MAP and MEASURE functions are prioritized, responded to, and managed.

functions.title: Strategies to maximize AI benefits and minimize negative impacts are planned, prepared, implemented, documented, and informed by input from relevant AI actors.

functions.title: AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.

functions.title: Risk treatments, including response and recovery, and communication plans for the identified and measured AI risks are documented and monitored regularly.
